name: controlflare
description: Controlflare's own plugins for Claude Code. Currently one: the hosted Controlflare MCP server, for reading Cloudflare spend and enforcing a hard monthly cap.

plugins.name: controlflare
plugins.description: A hard monthly billing cap for Cloudflare Workers. Read estimated month-to-date spend across Workers, D1, R2, KV and Durable Object requests, set or clear the cap, and pause or resume Workers. Four of the twelve tools stop production traffic.
